voice_synthesis.name: ElevenLabs
voice_synthesis.pros: Highest emotional range, human breath simulation, hyper-realistic inflections.
voice_synthesis.cons: Token-based pricing scales exponentially with high video volume.

voice_synthesis.name: Kokoro-82M
voice_synthesis.pros: Runs locally on CPU/GPU, ultra-fast generation, surprisingly high natural timbre.
voice_synthesis.cons: Fewer emotion presets than commercial cloud services.

voice_synthesis.name: OpenAI TTS (tts-1-hd)
voice_synthesis.pros: Predictable latency, natural articulation, clean modern sound.
voice_synthesis.cons: Voice selection limited to 6 presets, minimal speed/emotion sliders.

visual_generation.name: Midjourney v6
visual_generation.pros: Cinematic lighting, high-contrast character art, perfect for YouTube thumbnails.
visual_generation.cons: Discord-based workflow, lacks native API automation.

visual_generation.name: FLUX.1 (Schnell / Dev)
visual_generation.pricing: Free local / fractions of a cent via API
visual_generation.pros: State-of-the-art text rendering, photographic skin textures, runs on modern GPUs.
visual_generation.cons: Dev license non-commercial; Schnell is open Apache 2.0.

visual_generation.name: Runway Gen-3 Alpha
visual_generation.pros: Unmatched motion continuity and cinematic camera panning.

script_and_reasoning.name: Gemini 1.5 Flash
script_and_reasoning.pros: Massive 1M token context window, parses full video transcripts instantly, very fast.
script_and_reasoning.cons: Requires prompt tuning to eliminate standard corporate filler.

script_and_reasoning.name: DeepSeek-R1
script_and_reasoning.pros: Exceptional deep chain-of-thought analysis, superior logic breakdown.
script_and_reasoning.cons: Higher latency due to thinking tokens.

assembly_and_editing.name: Premiere Pro / After Effects
assembly_and_editing.pros: Industry-standard plugins, timeline precision, extensive motion graphics.
assembly_and_editing.cons: Heavy subscription lock-in, slow rendering on budget hardware.

assembly_and_editing.name: CapCut Desktop
assembly_and_editing.pros: Instant auto-captions with viral animations, built-in sound effects library.
assembly_and_editing.cons: Closed ecosystem, export watermarks on pro templates.
